question: National Waterway 2 (NW 2) is the Sadiya - Dhubri stretch of the ___________ river.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Brahmaputra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sadiya-Dhubri stretch of the Brahmaputra river is declared as the National Waterways 2 by the National Waterway act 1988.
 
• The waterway extends for a distance of 891 km from Dhubri to Sadiya.
